comments.body: High school grades typically don't have a major impact on your master's application, especially for a field like data science, where your undergraduate performance, relevant experience, and skills are more important. That said, some schools might still ask for them as part of their overall evaluation. Focus on highlighting your strengths—like any relevant projects or work experience you have in data science. If you're worried about your application, Interview Query can help you sharpen your skills through mock interviews and courses on SQL, Python, and more. Check out their [State of University Report](https://www.interviewquery.com/p/state-of-university-report) to see how schools evaluate applicants!
comments.author: ZookeepergameBig7491
